_note: TYPE CORRECTION: auto-gen tagged Q/W/E/R Physical, but all four of Corki's damaging abilities deal MAGIC damage in-game despite scaling off (bonus) AD ratios -- a well-documented Corki quirk. Q (Phosphorus Bomb) TotalDamage = BaseDamage + 1.25 bonusAD + 1.0 AP. W (Carpet Bomb) MaximumDamage = BaseDamage + 1.5 AP + 2.0 bonusAD (highest base+ratio sum in the kit, tagged BurstCeiling). E (Gatling Gun) TotalDamage = BaseDamage + 2.4 bonusAD; its ShredMax/ShredCap/ShredDuration DataValues confirm a real per-tick Armor-reduction debuff on struck targets (tagged ArmorShred). R (Missile Barrage) RSmallMissileDamage = BaseDamage + 0.85 bonusAD curated as the conservative single-missile hit; RBigMissileDamage (=2x, every 4th shot) exists but R is an ammo-based repeated-press skill rather than a discrete recast-combo (unlike Ahri R), so the smaller/typical value is kept rather than assuming the 4th-shot proc. P (Hextech Munitions/RapidReload) converts 20% of Corki's EXISTING basic-attack damage from physical to true (BasicAttackTOOLTIP = bonus AD * 0.2) rather than adding extra damage -- bonusEffects is strictly additive, so curating this as an onHit bonus would double-count the AA's own damage; left uncurated (no P entry).
